Manage pods, containers and images.

Usage:
  podman [command]

Available Commands:
  run         Run a command in a new container
  ps          List containers
  images      List images
  build       Build an image from a Containerfile
  pull        Pull an image from a registry
  push        Push an image to a registry
  rmi         Remove one or more images
  rm          Remove one or more containers
  logs        Fetch the logs of a container
  exec        Run a command in a running container

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for podman
      --log-level level  Log level (trace, debug, info, warn, error, fatal)
      --cgroup-manager manager  Cgroup manager to use (cgroupfs or systemd)

Use "podman [command] --help" for more information about a command.
